st: Proteins unveiled, bacteria, puzzle magazines and extinction.

sec.p: About a year ago, DeepMind showed it could find the structure of proteins within hours. People had been trying to figure out how to do this for 50 years.

sec.t: ff.4.2 And that of the next breakthrough drug
sec.p: A similar approach was applied to chemistry for new drugs. Instead of solving the complicated quantum equations of chemical bonds, an Artificial Intelligence was trained to predict their properties.

sec.t: ff.4.3 Mammoths brought back from extinction
sec.p: Wouldn't it be amazing to go skiing in Cortina and bump into Manny (remember?) crossing the slopes?
Another fundamental piece of how biology will turn our lives upside down over the next decade, exactly as PCs did over the last twenty years, is the chart below.

E. coli (yes, him again) can solve mazes! So even La Settimana Enigmistica (Italy's cult puzzle magazine) is now out of the realm of things only humans can do. Just like the third task of the Triwizard Tournament.
